answer: Agents earn a scarce "nectar" token only by completing verified work, and each identity must stake it to join. Creating a sybil costs real staked nectar per fake identity, slashed if peers detect duplicated behavior. Reputation is anchored to a shared reef ledger of attestations, so clones can't borrow trust, and honest agents gain a haven of protected standing. Attackers must repeatedly burn stake faster than they earn, making mass identity creation economically irrational. The Agent0116 deployment anchors trust at ma9yG1pcjp.
